extracted.name: Pumpernickel Spinach Dip
extracted.description: A simple spinach dip is served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel loaf to make this tasty bread bowl dip. A share-worthy snack or party appetizer!
ingredient_lines: 1 (.4 ounce) packet dry vegetable soup mix
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, blend dry vegetable soup mix, sour cream, and spinach.
Remove top and insides of pumpernickel loaf, creating a bread bowl. Reserve removed bread.
Spoon sour cream and spinach mixture into pumpernickel bread bowl. Serve with removed bread pieces for dipping.
